vehicles.name: Vehicles
vehicles.text: Every vehicle the party owns that takes fuel. Pick one to see its refuelling options.

options.name: Refuel options
options.text: Buy a set number of litres or fill the tank. The price of each option is shown beside it.

overview.name: Fuel overview
overview.text: The fuel level of the selected vehicle, the price per litre and what the party has in its wallet.

help.name: ? Help
help.text: Opens this sheet. On a controller, press Select; press it again, Back or Confirm to close.
